# WPS 200-299 Complexity

Every violation in the Complexity group of wemake-python-styleguide 1.8.1, from its [docs](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/complexity.html).
Disabled ones are struck through.

| Code | Violation | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| WPS200 | [JonesScoreViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/complexity.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.complexity.JonesScoreViolation) | Forbid modules with complex lines. |
| WPS201 | [TooManyImportsViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/complexity.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.complexity.TooManyImportsViolation) | Forbid modules with too many imports. |
| WPS202 | [TooManyModuleMembersViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/complexity.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.complexity.TooManyModuleMembersViolation) | Forbid too many classes and functions in a single module. |
| WPS203 | [TooManyImportedNamesViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/complexity.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.complexity.TooManyImportedNamesViolation) | Forbid modules with too many imported names. |
| WPS204 | [OverusedExpressionViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/complexity.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.complexity.OverusedExpressionViolation) | Forbid overused expressions in a module, function or method. |
| WPS210 | [TooManyLocalsViolation](https://wemake-python-styleguide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pages/usage/violations/complexity.html#wemake_python_styleguide.violations.complexity.TooManyLocalsViolation) | Forbid too many local variables in the unit of code. |
